cost_methodology_notes: Verifiable: own product or public per-request API price.

High-end estimate: consumer platforms (Perplexity Pro/Max app, Claude.ai with tools, Gemini Ultra/Advanced, ChatGPT Pro/Plus) have no per-query SKU. We compute a defensible upper bound by multiplying the per-system input + output token counts published in DRACO Table 10 by each underlying model's public API list price, plus reasoning-token markup (Anthropic extended thinking, OpenAI reasoning models bill these at output rate), plus per-system tool overhead (web search at $10-$35 per 1K calls depending on vendor, code execution time, document processing).

These estimates represent what a developer would pay if these systems were exposed via public API at standard rates; the actual user-facing subscription price may be lower per-query if the user fully exhausts their monthly allowance (Perplexity Pro $20/mo with ~20 deep researches, ChatGPT Pro $200/mo with 250 deep researches, etc.).

Consumer plans likely subsidize compute below the underlying cost; the 'high-end estimate' is therefore an upper bound on what these systems cost their providers, not what the end user pays out-of-pocket per query.
